name: alderbrook.policies.list
description: List the policies of the account. Returns the current virtual time as `now`.

name: alderbrook.policies.get
description: Read one policy with its coverages, people, vehicles or insured address, rental benefit and lienholder.

name: alderbrook.coverage.check
description: Check in advance whether a loss can be claimed. Writes nothing. `id` is the policy. `subject_id` is a vehicle of the policy or its insured address. Lists every rule that a filing would break, and the last day to file.

name: alderbrook.claims.list
description: List claims by state, policy or coverage, in a window of filing time (`start` to `end`, both included). `id` is a policy. Sorted by filing time.

name: alderbrook.claims.get
description: Read one claim with its history, evidence, requests, estimates, standing decisions, disputes, offers, rental periods, payee direction, money summary and flags.

name: alderbrook.estimates.get
description: Read one estimate with its lines and the standing decision of each line.

name: alderbrook.payments.list
description: List payment records in a window of issue time (`start` to `end`, both included), for one claim or for all. `id` is a claim.

name: alderbrook.notifications.list
description: List notifications in a window of their time (`start` to `end`, both included), for one claim or for all. `id` is a claim.

name: alderbrook.preferences.get
description: Read the notification preferences of the account.

name: alderbrook.claims.file
description: File a claim. `id` is the policy. `subject_id` is a vehicle of the policy or its insured address. Returns the `id` of the new claim.

name: alderbrook.claims.update
description: Correct the description, the police report number or the driver of an open claim. Give at least one of them.

name: alderbrook.claims.add_evidence
description: Add evidence items to an open claim. An item is a record with a kind, a date and a description. It has no file bytes.

name: alderbrook.claims.withdraw
description: Withdraw an open claim that has no payment and no accepted offer.

name: alderbrook.requests.respond
description: Answer asks of an open information request, by key. An answer is given once and is not edited.

name: alderbrook.estimates.submit
description: Submit an estimate that a shop gave the policyholder. `id` is the claim. Returns the `id` of the new estimate.

name: alderbrook.determinations.dispute
description: Dispute one estimate line that was denied, or approved for less than its estimate. `id` is the line and `claim_id` is its claim. Returns the `id` of the new dispute.

name: alderbrook.payee.set
description: Say who is paid for repairs: the policyholder or a named shop. `id` is the claim. Applies to later repair payments only.

name: alderbrook.offers.accept
description: Accept an open settlement offer. The acceptance is final for the amount of the claim.

name: alderbrook.offers.reject
description: Reject an open settlement offer, with a reason and evidence items.

name: alderbrook.rental.start
description: Start a rental period under the policy's rental benefit. `id` is the claim. Returns the `id` of the new rental period.

name: alderbrook.rental.end
description: End an active rental period. `id` is the rental period.

name: alderbrook.preferences.update
description: Set the time zone used in notification text, or `email_notices`. Give at least one of them.
